Absolutely loved the itinerary put together by Headnorth! Best part is it's customized basis each individual rather than the standard itineraries by most travel agencies for Ladakh. The hotels and accommodation were all tried and tested by the Founder himself, so we didn't face any challenges anywhere. Selecting a good hotel can be risky in Ladakh, but Headnorth really took care of it brilliantly for us. All we had to do was pack our bags and reach Leh, rest EVERYTHING was taken care of by them, we just had to sit back and enjoy :D
Cheers for you kind words! Look forward to welcoming both of you back soon !

Rinchen and Arif curated a great trip for Ladakh for my family. They exactly knew our requirements and made sure most of them were achieved. Hotel selections by then were fabulous and highlight of the trip was our driver, he was extremely professional and helpful. Just one pointer from my side, do not stay at Pangong lake as the accommodation is beyond basic and they not have any heating.

Rest assured, Ladakh is one of the most beautiful places I have visited in the world and Headnorth made it easier for us to manoeuvre around.

Rinchen and the Headnorth team are superstars at curating a Ladakh trip. They're passionate about bringing the average traveler closer to the authentic Ladakh experience and also pay attention to details that your run of the mill travel agencies skip. For instance, they have a simple Google form to understand your interest areas and what you want out of your holiday, after which they start stitching up a plan that fits. Apart from that, they're nimble when it comes to changing up the itinerary on the go. We were hit with bad weather which affected some of our plans but they were quick to find alternatives which worked out equally well for the day.
Ladakh will be a special memory for me and a lot of it has to do with the Headnorth team. Kudos!
Better late than never, cheers Avni for those words and for acknowledging our effort to put our best foot forward for each client 😂🤗
